$comment: The tiered read-list from docs/COMPANY_BUILD_PLAN.md (TIER 1, 25 files) as data, so scripts/check-review-coverage.mjs can print `Tier 1: N/25` every run and ratchet on it. N counts files whose best live ledger row is at or above targetDepth. `mark` is the last accepted N: the gate FAILS when N falls below it (a read cannot be un-read except by retirement) and is raised by hand when N rises. Staleness (commits to the file since the row's `sha`, or since its `date` when no sha is recorded) is REPORTED, never fatal — it is the queue for the next re-read, not a lie about the last one.
